item.title: Ethereum collected 16% of all fees among its peers, up from 12%
item.description: Ethereum had 16% of 30-day fees among 29 peer chains on 2 Oct 2026, against 12% thirty days earlier. Source: DefiLlama.

item.title: Uniswap handled 37% of DEX trading in the last 30 days, up from 26%
item.description: Uniswap had 37% of 30-day trading volume among 14 peer DEXs on 29 Sep 2026, against 26% thirty days earlier. Source: DefiLlama.
